_comment: docs/152. Verifiers that FAIL on purpose when the all-on-rehearsal Config values reach them, because they pin the COMMITTED off state of a flag (or build their own default/playtest variant from the Config text). tools/run_rehearsal.py treats a failure as expected only when its output matches `signature` AND every other failing line matches `only` (when given); anything else is reported as an INTERACTION. An entry whose verifier passes in the rehearsal is reported as stale. The verifier is still run in normal CI, where the flag-on paths are covered by the clones the verifier flips itself.

verify_world_art.py.signature: default must keep the current look
verify_world_art.py.reason: pins WorldArtMode/FoodArtMode = Legacy for the default; the rehearsal (like the playtest) uses BiomeKit/Kit. Kit food is covered by verify_gameplay (docs/152 FoodService fix)

verify_gameplay.py.reason: pins SpecialFoodsEnabled false at runtime; the tests after this line (predation egg bonus, nest weather) are not reached in the rehearsal and run in CI

verify_objectives.py.signature: the committed Config has the flag off
verify_objectives.py.reason: pins ObjectivesEnabled false; the on-state is exercised on clones in the same file when run in CI

verify_objective_hooks.py.signature: the committed Config has the flag off
verify_objective_hooks.py.reason: same pin; the hook sites themselves are checked statically before it and by verify_multiplayer_sim / verify_load with the flag on

verify_spawn.py.reason: builds its default and playtest variants from the Config text and expects CaveHub false in the default one

verify_mouth_reach.py.reason: pins FoodPickupAtMouth/PredationAtMouth false (MR6); every numeric check of the verifier passed

verify_progression.py.signature: the committed Config has the fusion flag off
verify_progression.py.reason: pins IdentityFusionPreviewEnabled false before its off-state fusion checks

verify_rollback.py.signature: preserved untouched while the flags are off
verify_rollback.py.reason: the rollback drill is about a build with the flags OFF reading data a flags-ON build wrote

verify_gifts.py.signature: the committed Config has all three flags off
verify_gifts.py.only: committed Config has all three flags off
verify_gifts.py.reason: pins the three gift flags false; all other gift checks passed

verify_gift_ui.py.signature: the committed Config has all three flags off
verify_gift_ui.py.only: committed Config has all three flags off
verify_gift_ui.py.reason: same pin; all other gift UI checks passed

verify_multiplayer_sim.py.reason: the three scenario families that assert the flag-OFF state (perk refused, no objective hook, hub size rule off); the 673 other checks passed with every flag on

verify_class_picker.py.signature: the committed Config has the class movement and combat flags off
